en.headline: Sun Hung Kai Properties underlying profit rises 4.6 percent to HK$22.85 billion
en.dek: Hong Kong’s largest developer reported stronger residential sales and a final dividend of HK$2.93, lifting the full-year payout as the local property market continued its recovery.
body: Sun Hung Kai Properties said underlying profit for the year ended 30 June rose 4.6 per cent to HK$22.85 billion, excluding fair-value changes on investment properties, while reported profit increased to HK$21.43 billion.

The group recorded attributable contracted sales of about HK$38.1 billion in Hong Kong, with major contributions from Sierra Sea at Sai Sha Residences and the Cullinan projects in Kai Tak. Revenue rose 18.2 per cent to HK$94.19 billion, driven largely by property development.

Chairman and managing director Raymond Kwok said the residential market continued to recover on improved economic conditions and talent inflows. The company declared a final dividend of HK$2.93 per share, bringing the full-year dividend to HK$3.91.

zh.headline: 新鴻基地產基礎溢利升4.6%至228.5億元
zh.dek: 本港最大發展商全年合約銷售約381億元，末期息2.93元，全年派息3.91元，物業市場持續復甦。
body: 新鴻基地產公布截至6月30日止年度業績，撇除投資物業公平值變動後的基礎溢利升4.6%至228.5億元，帳面溢利增至214.3億元。
集團本港應佔合約銷售約381億元，主要來自西沙的Sierra Sea及啟德的天璽系列項目。收入升18.2%至941.9億元，主要由物業發展帶動。
主席兼董事總經理郭炳聯表示，住宅市場在經濟改善及人才流入下持續復甦。公司宣布末期息每股2.93元，全年派息3.91元。
